description: Source code for utility functions related to TR-069 protocol handling, including IPC initialization, parameter get/set, error handling, and command-line parsing.

methods.name: initilize
methods.description: Initializes IPC connectivity via IARM bus, retries until successful.

methods.name: getErrorDetails
methods.description: Returns textual description of error codes from IARM bus call results.

methods.name: getParamType
methods.description: Retrieves parameter type via IARM bus call, if supported.

methods.name: convertParamValues
methods.description: Converts string input to appropriate parameter value based on type.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts a character code to a parameter type enumeration.

methods.name: printParameterDetails
methods.description: Prints details of a parameter retrieved from the host interface.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves property value via IARM bus call.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets property value via IARM bus call.

methods.name: term
methods.description: Cleans up IPC connection by disconnecting and terminating IARM bus.

methods.name: parseargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for get/set operations and parameters.

methods.name: trsetutil
methods.description: Main utility function handling argument parsing, IPC initialization, and property get/set.
